programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The first day of the two-part finale sees the strongest men competing in Carry and Drag, Dumbbell Lift and the Truck Pull. Everything is possible in this heated fight for the crown against the backdrop of stunning Chetumal, Mexico.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: On the second day of the grand finale of the 2017 Strongman Champions League, the athletes have a last chance to secure the medals in the spectacular four events Weight for Height, Deadlift Cars, Forward Hold and The Loading Medley. Be prepared for stunning performances – and even world records!

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Season 2018 begins with 14 strongest men in the world, all competing for the title. The competition kicks off in Norway. We’ll see typical Viking disciplines, team events and world records in heavy conditions in the land of snow and ice. They will suffer, they will freeze and fight in this first competition of the year for the title that they will carry on their shoulders throughout whole year.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The next stop in strongest league of the world is muscle capital, largest number of strong shoulders per capichampions league on the planet. It’s a FIBO - the biggest expo on planet Earth and the second stage of 2018 Strongman champions league, in Cologne, Germany.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: For the first time in history, Strongman Champions League will set up competition in Abu Dhabi. The line-up of super athletes, who are part of the SCL, includes former world champions Dainis Zageris (Latvia) & Krzysztof Radzikowski (Poland), current world champion Matjaz Belsak (Slovenia) and biggest strongman in the World Sean O’Hagan (Ireland).

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Strongman classic in land where there is no place for anything else excepts strength, fight and endurance. Here are fourteen of the strongest men, fighting for the title of strongest in Holland.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: We go back to Holland, where former champion Dainis Zageris is in leading position after the first three events. Alongside Radzikowski, he is in this moment favorite for world title, and also leader shirt holder.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Stage six of Strongman champions league, 2018 is set back on north, in Finland. Here we have Matjaz Belsak, wearing SCL leader shirt, one of the biggest strongman in the World Mika Torro, fan favorite strongman in all over the World – Will Baggott, and also big name from Baltic – Aivars Smaukstelis

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Twelve strongman, including defending Worldchampion Matjaz Belsak from Slovenia , will compete on “Air spa” for the title of best in homeland country of Tesla, Pupin, Novak Djokovic. Matjaz Belsak is the SCL leader in this competition, chasing his third victory this season.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The World championship in lightweights of the Strongman Champions League bring to us 50 strongmen from all over the world. All athletes are under 105 kilograms and for them this is the step up to the ultimate heavyweights.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: In this second stage of the World championship of lightweights we will find out who out of the 12 athletes will win the title in the under 105 kilogram category.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The first part of SCL Romania 2018 will be hosted in Brasov. This episode features a new event for Strongman Champion League: “ The Chopper Pull”!

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: After three classical Strongman events – Dead lift, Loading and Front hold – and one historical, Chopper Pull for the first time in history of Strongman, now we go to find out who will take title in Romania. This is the second stage in Romania and it remains to be seen who will win the title; Aivars, Travis or Krzyzstof?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The next destination of Strongman Champions League is in a piece of paradise on earth – Curacao. We bring to you some special Strongman events like the Rock Lift, Tug of War and Weight for Height in this episode.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: This is the last competition before the grand finals. After the first three events Zageris is in top place, but can O’Hagan, Baggott, Petursson and Ortmayer step into the final? Last chance some of them will find through events like Forward Hold, Truck Pull, Dead Lift and loading very big objects.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: We bring you 50 minutes of Strongman inside. Fears, inspiration, courage, the best and worst from our finalists and their expectation of the finals. We also go to Poland and Germany to represent one day in the training of Krzysztof Radzikowski and Dennis Kohlruss. See all the finalists for Mexico in their comfort zone here, with their backgrounds /motivations /family and friends.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The first part of the Strongman Champions League 2018 finals in Mexico. The last twelve athletes all pushing their boundaries and testing their limits to take the World title.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: After 11 months and 14 competitions all over the world, it all comes down to the final in this episode. The strongmen must show their best skills and every mistake is expensive, so their concentration must be at the highest possible level. Will Krzysztof manage to take off back or will Dainis maintain his lead?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: This year 14 athletes from all over the world came to Fefor to compete in 6 cruel events. We'll see typical Viking disciplines on very heavy conditions in land of snow and ice, World records and athletes like the title defender Krzysztof Radzikowski, strongest guys from Holland and Germany and many more

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The next stop in strongest league of the world is muscle capital, largest number of strong shoulders per capita in the World and of course, the most powerful host in Strongman champions league on the planet. It’s a FIBO - the biggest expo on planet Earth and the second stage of 2019 Strongman champions league, in Cologne, Germany.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: On a spectacular beach in Alanya, the MLO Strongman Champions League Turkey was viewed by thousands of spectators over a two day battle. With 12 athletes at the start over 6 cruel events, like Marble Stone Lift, Truckpull and Deadlift cars. And with the comeback of Travis Ortmayer / USA, former stone king and world ranked competitor. Winner of several SCL stages in the past.

programme.title: Ride on - Die zweite Chance
programme.desc: Geldprobleme und eine entfremdete Tochter: Der einst glorreiche Stuntman Lao Luo (Jackie Chan) hat schon bessere Zeiten gehabt. Nun soll sogar sein geliebtes Stuntpferd "Roter Hase" gepfändet werden! Es kommt zum Showdown mit fiesen Geldeintreibern. Als das Video der Konfrontation viral geht, erlangt das dynamische Duo zwar neue Berühmtheit, aber die Schulden stehen weiterhin im Raum. Zusammen mit seiner Tochter Xiao Bao (Haocun Liu) und ihrem Freund, dem Rechtsanwalt Naihua (Qilin Guo), versucht der furchtlose Stuntman wieder in die Spur zu kommen. - Das Werk von Larry Yang wurde u.a. beim Chinese American Film Festival ausgezeichnet.

programme.title: The Knight of Shadows: Between Yin and Yang
programme.desc: Der Menschheit steht eine epische Schlacht bevor. Dämonenjäger Pu Songling (Jackie Chan) wird entsandt, um mittels Magie böse Kräfte ins Schattenreich zu verbannen. Doch der Weg zum Erfolg ist ein steiniger. Zudem sorgen, auf rätselhafte Weise verschwundene Frauen für Verunsicherung bei der Bevölkerung. Zusammen mit guten Geistern, wohlgesonnenen Kreaturen sowie einer Handvoll tapferer Mitstreiter zieht Pus furchtlose Truppe los, um Drachen, Monstern und Seeungeheuern die Stirn zu bieten. Doch die größte Herausforderung steht noch bevor: Die geraubten Frauen aus den Fängen der mächtigen Dämonin Xiaoqian (Elane Zhong) zu befreien. - Zauberhafter Fantasy- und Abenteuerfilm aus chinesischer ...

programme.title: Hercules
programme.desc: Die Insel des Todes - In einer antiken Welt voll von mystischen Rätseln und sagenhaften Kreaturen gibt es einen Mann, der sich dem Bösen furchtlos entgegenstellt: Hercules (Kevin Sorbo). Der Sohn des Göttervaters Zeus ist ein mutiger Kämpfer und verfügt über Bärenkräfte. Bei seinem Feldzug für die Gerechtigkeit und zum Schutz unschuldiger Menschen kämpft ein weiterer tapferer Held an der Seite des Halbgotts: Iolaus (Michael Hurst), Hercules' bester Freund und Weggefährte. Dies sind ihre legendären Geschichten und fantastischen Abenteuer. - Heldenepos und Fantasy-Klassiker der 90er-Jahre.

programme.title: Expedition Unknown - Mythen auf der Spur
programme.desc: Jagd nach den Schlangenkönigen - Von den Pyramiden der Mayas über die Schiffsreisen der Wikinger bis zu den legendären Steinkreisen von Stonehenge: Josh Gates ist in "Expedition Unknown" historischen Mythen auf der Spur - packenden Geschichtsrätseln, die bis heute Fragen aufwerfen. Was hat es mit den Ruinen von El Mirador auf sich? Sind unerschrockene Nordmänner aus Skandinavien im Mittelalter über den Atlantik bis nach Amerika gesegelt - lange bevor Christoph Kolumbus die Neue Welt entdeckte? Und welchem Zweck dienten die Megalith-Monumente nahe der englischen Stadt Salisbury? Diese Doku-Serie liefert spannende Fakten und zeigt auf, wo die Expertenmeinungen auseinandergehen.

programme.title: Stargate
programme.desc: Der Planet des Wassers - Das Stargate, aufgebaut in einem geheimen US-Militärkomplex, ist das Relikt einer uralten Zivilisation. Über dieses Tor gelangt man sekundenschnell zu unzähligen anderen Planeten, auf denen sich weitere Stargates befinden. Das Team von Colonel Jack O'Neill (Richard Dean Anderson) hat die Aufgabe, über diese besonderen Alltransfers Kontakte zu anderen Zivilisationen zu knüpfen und die Erde gegen Angriffe von außen zu schützen, aber auch die Entstehung des Lebens und Lebensformen auf fremden Planeten zu erforschen. - Die Serie basiert auf Roland Emmerichs gleichnamigem Kinofilm (1994) und setzt dessen Handlung direkt fort.

programme.title: The Orville
programme.desc: Verschollen im Weltraum - Am Rand des erforschten Weltraums stößt die "Orville" auf ein riesiges Objekt. Captain Ed Mercer und seine Crew haben ein überdimensionales Generationen-Raumschiff entdeckt. Der super schlaue KI-Android Isaac (Mark Jackson) schätzt das Alter der kosmischen Arche auf 2.000 Jahre. Die Biosphäre im Inneren umfasst Isaacs Berechnungen zufolge eine Fläche, so groß wie New York City. Als Ed und ein Erkundungstrupp per Shuttle an das kolossale Konstrukt andocken, machen sie eine unglaubliche Entdeckung. Dort leben Menschen in einer illusorischen Scheinwelt, die keine Ahnung haben, dass sie sich an Bord eines Mega-Raumschiffs befinden.

programme.title: Snowpiercer
programme.desc: Das Desinteresse des Universums - Die Erde hat sich durch eine globale Klimakatastrophe in eine gewaltige Kugel aus Eis und Schnee verwandelt. Die letzten Überlebenden befinden sich im "Snowpiercer", einem futuristischen Zug, der durch die gefrorene Welt fährt und zur Zufluchtsstätte geworden ist. Auch der Kriminalpolizist Andre Layton (Daveed Diggs) und die Chefingenieurin Melanie Cavill (Jennifer Connelly) sind an Bord des Superzugs, wo strenge Hierarchien herrschen. Zwar gibt es Hoffnung auf ein Ende der Eiszeit, aber bis es soweit ist, entbrennt in den Waggons ein schonungsloser Klassenkampf. - Die postapokalyptisch-dystopische Sciencefiction-Serie basiert auf dem französischen Comicbuch "Le Transperceneige".

programme.title: Der Legionär
programme.desc: Boxer Alain Lefevre (Jean-Claude Van Damme) hat ein Problem. Im Marseille der 1920er Jahre hat er Mafiaboss Lucien Galgani (Jim Carter) gelinkt. Um seine Haut zu retten, gibt es nur eine Lösung, und die heißt Flucht! Kurzerhand setzt Lefevre nach Marokko über und heuert bei der französischen Fremdenlegion an. Was folgt, ist eine knüppelharte Grundausbildung bei Sklaventreiber Sergeant Steinkampf (Steven Berkoff). Doch der Militäreinsatz in der Wüste Nordafrikas wird noch schlimmer. Dort bekommt es der Legionär mit wehrhaften Berberstämmen und Galganis Schergen zu tun. - Action und Abenteuer pur: Kampfmaschine Jean-Claude Van Damme schlägt wieder zu.

programme.title: American Fighter 3: Die blutige Jagd
programme.desc: Karate-Ass Sean (David Bradley) fliegt in die Karibik, um zu kämpfen. Was als harmloser Wettkampf beginnt, wird bald zu einem Spiel auf Leben und Tod. Denn der verbrecherische General Andreas (Yehuda Efroni) plant geheime Genmanipulationen. Zum Glück springt Sean sein alter Kumpel Curtis (Steve James) zur Seite. - In den ersten zwei "American Fighter"-Teilen war Michael Dudikoff in der Hauptrolle zu sehen, diesmal spielt David Bradley den "American Ninja"-Protagonisten. Sidekick im dritten Teil ist, wie in den beiden Vorläufern, Steve James.

programme.title: Arabellas Crime Time - Verbrechen im Visier
programme.desc: Snatched - Ein Passant beobachtet, wie eine Frau in ein Auto gezerrt wird. Er will helfen, doch der Angreifer zieht eine Waffe und schießt - aber die Pistole hat eine Ladehemmung. "Arabellas Crime Time" zeigt dramatische Geschichten hinter schockierenden Verbrechen, die viral gehen. Von Profi-Überwachungsgeräten bis hin zu Handycams - fast immer schaut jemand zu. Atemberaubende Clips von Entführungen, Einbrüchen, Verfolgungsjagden und anderen Gewaltverbrechen bringen Millionen von Views ein. Doch diese Doku-Serie geht über das spannende Filmmaterial hinaus, um die ganze Geschichte zu erzählen. Präsentiert werden die Fälle von Moderatorin Arabella Kiesbauer.

programme.title: Der Sturm - Life on the Line
programme.desc: Jahrelang kümmerte sich Beau (John Travolta) nach dem Tod seines Bruders und dessen Frau um seine Nichte. Jetzt ist Bailey (Kate Bosworth) erwachsen. Doch statt ihren Weg weit weg von den "Linemen", Stromtechnikern wie Beau und ihr Vater, zu gehen, sucht sich Bailey einen Freund in deren Reihen: Duncan (Devon Sawa) ist Lineman der zweiten Generation. Da zieht ein bedrohlicher Sturm auf. - Hauptdarsteller John Travolta, selbst Scientologe, erhielt von der Scientology Church die Erlaubnis, in dem Film mitzuwirken, obwohl die Lehre der Sekte besagt, dass Elektrizität "eine abscheuliche unnatürliche Erfindung von Xenu (dem Teufel) selbst" sei.

programme.title: Farang
programme.desc: Der Drogendealer Sam (Nassim Lyes) hat mit seiner kriminellen Vergangenheit in Paris abgeschlossen. Aber als der flüchtige Ex-Häftling alles hinter sich lässt und in Thailand gemeinsam mit seiner Freundin Mia (Loryn Nounay) ein neues Leben als Familienvater beginnt, gerät er wieder mit den falschen Leuten in Kontakt. Nachdem Sam den Zorn des lokalen Unterweltbosses Narong (Olivier Gourmet) auf sich gezogen hat, geschieht eine abstoßende Gräueltat: Killer ermorden Mia, die zudem schwanger ist! Der "Farang", also der Ausländer, sieht Rot und startet einen blutigen Rachefeldzug in Bangkok. - Gangster-Drama des französischen Regisseurs Xavier Gens.

programme.title: Pasión de gavilanes

programme.title: Pasión de gavilanes
programme.desc: Martín descubre a los amantes y empieza a gritar, desesperado Fernando le tapa la boca hasta desmayarlo, lo da por muerto y monta el cuerpo en el carro para deshacerse de él, Martín reacciona.

programme.title: Pasión de gavilanes
programme.desc: Martín despierta en un sanatorio, los empleados de los Reyes reportan normalidad en la hacienda Elizondo; sin embargo, las hermanas deciden comprobar por sus propios medios lo que sucede.

programme.title: Pasión de gavilanes
programme.desc: El administrador del sanatorio descubre quién es Martín y lo manipula para que no diga nada, Hortencia se interesa en él. Sarita, Ruth y Antonio vigilan el rancho Elizondo por las noches.

programme.title: Pasión de gavilanes
programme.desc: Gabriela llega al cuarto de su papá y encuentra a Malcolm vestido como él, Dínora le asegura que si firma el poder para que Fernando pueda vender la hacienda, la llevan a ver a Martín.

programme.title: Pasión de gavilanes
programme.desc: Rosario visita el rancho Elizondo con el pretexto de saludar a Gabriela y a Martín, pero Armando le prohíbe que regrese allí. Fernando siente que la situación se le va de las manos.

programme.title: Pasión de gavilanes
programme.desc: El doctor Bustillo visita a su primo, le confiesa que descubrió que el paciente es su suegro y le pide el doble de dinero, pero lo que gana es una golpiza por parte de los hombres de Fernando.

programme.title: Pasión de gavilanes
programme.desc: Hortencia escucha cuando Bustillo menciona que tiene que matar al viejo, ella le dice a Martín que no tome ninguna pastilla que le den. Los Reyes y las Elizondo subastan las joyas de Eduvina.

programme.title: Pasión de gavilanes
programme.desc: Raquel le aclara a Benito que toda la herencia va a ser para Ruth, aunque estén molestas y tengan diferentes opiniones sobre los Reyes. Fernando piensa en otras formas de presionar a Gabriela.

programme.title: Pasión de gavilanes
programme.desc: Gabriela grita para que Raquel la escuche y la ayude, la amiga va al sótano y la ve amordazada, al no poderla liberar huye y tiene un accidente fatal. Se cumple otro sueño premonitorio de Ruth.

programme.title: Pasión de gavilanes
programme.desc: Ruth está desconsolada por la muerte de sus padres, ahora más que nunca necesita el apoyo de sus amigos. Dínora tortura psicológicamente a Gabriela, le dice que por su culpa, Raquel murió.

programme.title: Pasión de gavilanes
programme.desc: En medio del funeral, Benito arma un escándalo, le reclama a Ruth por dejar sola a Raquel y le dice que ella no tiene derecho a disponer de la fortuna. Ruth presenta a su verdadera madre.

programme.title: Timmy Time
programme.desc: Being an ‘only lamb in the flock’ Timmy has been used to getting his own way. Now for the first time Timmy is going to have to learn to get along with other little animals. Timmy is going to Nursery! Self-willed and naughty Timmy is going to have to learn how to share things with other youngsters and think about their feelings – not just his. Timmy is a gifted little footballer who needs to learn that it’s not enough to kick the ball – you have to pass it too. Harriet Heron and Osbourne Owl, who run the Nursery are going to have their hands full, but Timmy gets it right in the end with a little help from his friends of the furry, feathery and spikey type.

programme.title: Misha, the Purple Cat
programme.desc: Misha is a very lively, alert cat. She is very interested in investigating everything going on around her, which means she has some very entertaining adventures with her friends. programme.title: Princess Play Time
programme.desc: The proud Princess likes to do things her own way, but her antics are always joined by her restless brother, Prince, who tends to turn everything topsy-turvy. Any playtime in their room transforms into a fantastic journey through unusual worlds: the children arrange a picnic on the Moon, conduct a detective investigation in a toy city, or search for pirate treasures on islands! Although initially, the Princess and Prince seem to clash and compete, by the end, they always find joy in each other's company and that of their cherished dog, Bona.

programme.title: Bino & Fino
programme.desc: Bino & Fino is about a brother and sister named Bino and Fino who live with their grandparents 'Mama' and 'Papa' in a modern day city in Africa. Bino and Fino have many adventures where, with the help of their friend Zeena the Magic Butterfly, they discover and learn things about the world.

programme.title: Ebb and Flo
programme.desc: The world of Ebb and Flo is seen through Ebb’s eyes and Ebb reveals all the emotions grown-ups try to hide. Flo doesn’t think of Ebb as a dog, and Ebb doesn’t think of Flo as a small human, they just are the best of friends. Until Bird arrives to lovingly disrupt Ebb’s world. Ebb and Flo’s home is an old boat moored by the beach. Things Couldn’t Be Better!

programme.title: Horaci the Inuit

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Romance seems close for Thing, the Addams right-hand-in-a-box, when Gomez's aunt arrives for a visit accompanied by Lady Fingers, her handmaiden. Thing enjoys the visit most because it gives him a chance to hold hands with one of his own kind.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez visit Mayor Henson to complain that their property tax is ridiculously low. After the Mayor proves his incompetence by offering a refund, Gomez is persuaded to become a candidate for the office.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: During a welcome home party for Cousin Itt, Morticia notices that the diminutive guest of honor seems to be losing his hair. Uncle Fester experiments with his chemistry set to produce a concoction that grows hair and tries the remedy on Itt.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Wednesday and Pugsley return in tears from trick-or-treating because a neighbor has told them there is no such thing as a witch. Morticia and Gomez plan to prove to the children that they do exist--by summoning a witch to a séance.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Determined to correct the dreadful literature that Wednesday and Pugsley are exposed to, Morticia sets out to create a new literary world. Gomez fears that his wife's first manuscript is so good, that once the publisher reads it, he will lose her.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: In need of artistic fulfillment, Morticia takes up sculpting. An art critic views her first endeavor--a three-eyed Gomez statue--and clubs it with his cane. Gomez, who won't have Morticia's heart broken gets, a seedy art dealer to buy it.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley copies one of his dad's old love letters and sends it to his teacher. Miss Dunbar comes to visit the Addams home and confesses to Gomez that no man has ever fallen so in love with her, leading Morticia to pretend to be the jealous wife.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: After Wednesday befriends a new boy her age, Robespierre Courtney, Morticia invites his parents, Mr. and Mrs. Henry Courtney, to visit the Addams house for tea. Unbeknownst to them, the Courtney's are hoping to meet a number of the social set.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: There is a neighborhood burglar on the loose, and Morticia has reason to believe it could be Gomez. Morticia decides to probe his subconscious mind for a key to his criminality after she and Uncle Fester discover loot hidden in the storeroom.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's pet plant Cleopatra gobbles up her favorite photo of Gomez from the family album. When the original photographer is found and asked to make a duplicate picture, it is discovered that he is now with the Department of Motor Vehicles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez plays host to Don Xavier Molines, a family friend during his childhood in Spain, and his daughter, Consuella. Morticia's hospitality is put to the test when Consuella reveals that she has been promised in marriage to Gomez since childhood.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Wednesday's and Pugsley's faith in Santa Claus is shaken, Uncle Fester is chosen to back up Santa in case the real St. Nick is too busy to come. However, Fester-Santa gets stuck in the chimney, so each of the other adults fill in for him.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Fester is so smitten upon receipt of a photo of his love, a bearded carnival lady, that he borrows stamp money to mail her a proposal. Morticia dons a beard and poses as the mother to convince Fester that he will have to work to support a wife.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Because she thinks Fester (Jackie Coogan) and Grandmama (Blossom Rock) are spoiling the children, Morticia (Carolyn Jones) hires a governess. Insulted, Fester paints a white line down the center of the Addams house, dividing it in half.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez see Fester conferring with TV muscleman Jack LaGrann (Jack LaLanne), and think that Fester is planning a television career. However, Uncle Fester confides to Lurch that he has to go on a secret diet and exercise.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez find Grandfather Pegleg's treasure map and summon Captain Grimby. They hope to charter his boat for the treasure hunt. But after meeting the Captain, Morticia is careful to keep the nature of the mission secret.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Ophelia Frump is madly in love with Horatio Bartholomew, the man who has everything, except the truth about her relatives. Morticia, not convinced by Bartholomew, persuades playboy Cousin Itt to stir the embers of his past romance with Ophelia.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley shocks his parents when he gives up his new atomic reactor as kid stuff and announces that he wants to find his own job. His first try is as a medical assistant to Dr. Bird. He turns up, scalpel in hand, ready to help during an operation.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandma Frump (guest star Margaret Hamilton) comes to the mistaken conclusion that her daughter, Morticia (Carolyn Jones), and Gomez (John Astin) plan to pack her off to an old folks home. Actually, they plan to send her to a beauty farm.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia, in order to be part of the National Beautification Program, decides to become a home decorator and offers her services to the neighbors. Next door neighbor, and insurance agent, Joe Digby hires Morticia in hopes of selling them insurance.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Ophelia taunts Uncle Fester into announcing that he is going to join the Peace Corps. Fester feels he's a cinch to be accepted because Gomez plans to pull strings in Washington on his behalf. The entire family agrees to help him study for the exam.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Allyn Joslyn guest-stars as Sam Hilliard, a former truant officer who now heads a private school where Wednesday and Pugsley are enrolled. When Hilliard breaks under the strain of dealing with the Addams children, Gomez buys the school.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Dr. Marvin P. Gunderson is summoned to examine Kitty Kat, the ailing lion pet of the Addams Family. Morticia decides that it is the doctor who needs help. To build his confidence, human members of the family pretend to be ill so he can affect cures.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's concern that Lurch is overworked leads Gomez to the operating table to assemble a custom-built secondary butler. Lurch lets the robot do all the work and then begins to feel that he isn't needed anymore.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Uncle Fester incinerates the family's stuffed bear with his flamethrower, Morticia reports the accident to the insurance company. Mr. Henson, the head of the company, sends his assistant, Mr. Digby, to handle the case.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch suffers from unrequited love over Tiny Trivia (guest star Diane Jergens), Morticia's visiting school chum who only has eyes for show business. The entire family decides to try to turn their stolid butler in to a new personality.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Ophelia laments that she has been jilted, Morticia suggests a career as an alternative to marriage. She tries chemistry first (with explosive results) then turns to operatic singing. Cousin Itt is summoned to coach her to stardom.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez decide to keep Wednesday and Pugsley home from school after Morticia sees the fairy tales they have to read. When the truant officer comes to investigate, he is shocked at what he finds.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia calls a psychiatrist after she fears Pugsley is becoming normal after he abandons his pet octopus for a puppy and is seen wearing a Boy Scout uniform, playing with a baseball bat, and helping an old lady cross the street.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester, who has become lonely, convinces Gomez and Morticia that it is time for him to find a bride. He decides to put an ad in the newspaper, looking for love. But things go awry when a door-to-door saleswoman comes by.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Election fever grips the Addams household, as Gomez (John Astin) supports the council candidate whose campaign promise is to drain the town's disgusting bogs. Morticia (Carolyn Jones), who likes "the lovely bogs," labels the candidate an extremist.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley and Wednesday start a row at a party when their gift of a tarantula upsets Harold, the birthday boy. Harold's parents insist that the Addams children lack breeding and, therefore, are no longer allowed to play with their son.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: After Pugsley befriends Gorgo, a circus gorilla, Gorgo decides to follow Pugsley and Gomez home, where he is accepted as one of the family. But Gorgo gives Morticia's tea guests, the Ladies League members, quite a shock.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: A pair of bank robbers are welcomed as Halloween trick-or-treaters by Morticia and Gomez. The creepy atmosphere of the house, Morticia's smoldering holiday punch and Lurch's ominous presence impel the crooks to abandon their plans.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Lionel Barker, a former suitor of Morticia, shows up, Gomez is jealous. But he's soon calmed when he learns that Barker is after Mildred, the new maid. The Addamses then discover that Barker is a con man--after Mildred's money, not her love.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Newlyweds move in next door. But the honeymoon loses its tranquility when Uncle Fester enters their house through a tunnel and they flee in terror at the sight of Lurch, Grandmama sharpening her ax, and Morticia and Gomez bathing the octopus.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The family faces a crisis when Wednesday packs her spider and runs away (after being scolded for playing with Uncle Fester's TNT). When they try to file a missing person report, a detective is anxious to retire early due to their story.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Official visitors from an unfriendly nation receive the shock of their lives when they decide to exploit the Addams Family as an average uncultured family. The visitors are shaken up by Morticia's carnivorous plants among other things.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's cousin, Melancholia, wants to marry Clarence P. Harvey after most of her marital prospects have joined the Foreign Legion. Clarence recoils when Melancholia puts on a campaign to win him, backed by Morticia, Gomez and Clarence's boss.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch becomes a veritable gazelle when he takes dancing lessons at Gomez and Morticia's suggestion, after he admits to being a wallflower at social functions. Each member of the Addams Family teaches Lurch a different step.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandmama's paintings leave an art critic speechless, so Gomez sends for his friend, Sam Picasso, to teach Grandmama to paint in the abstract. The starving artist ignores Grandmama's and Morticia's work as he eats and paints.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Rockland Cartright III is a beatnik who crashes his motorbike into a tree and recuperates at the Addams house. Each regards the other as an oddity, although the family learns to appreciate certain aspects of Rockland's life.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Mr. Briggs, the postman, is hired by the government to do undercover work in the Addams house. While pretending to be a stamp collector, he investigates rumors that coded radio messages are being sent from the house.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch's tiny fire-eating mother visits and demands that Lurch's employers wait on her boy hand-and-foot after Lurch leads her to believe that it's his house. Lurch revels in the unexpected attention he gets from Morticia and Gomez.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester's electrical output fails abruptly. Should they call a doctor or an electrician to bring Fester back? Morticia prescribes a bowl of porcupine mold, and both she an Gomez agree that long exposure to moon rays would be beneficial.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The family would like to vacation on the moon, but the billion dollar travel cost is slightly prohibitive. Uncle Fester volunteers $21.13 and Morticia, using Gomez's new supercomputer, suggests placing a $2,000 bet on the daily double horse race.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Cousin Itt is advocated as curator of the local zoo. Gomez uses his influence with Park Commissioner Fisk (guest star Alan Reed) to promote Itt for the job, but the zookeepers are convinced the Addamses' cousin should be confined to a cage.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandmama (Blossom Rock) is hauled off to jail for setting up a fortune-telling booth in the Addamses' living room. Gomez (John Astin) volunteers to act as attorney, and the court session becomes a shambles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez (John Astin) loses his memory after hitting his head; he fails to recognize Morticia (Carolyn Jones), and says the house looks like a condemned museum. The Addamses take turns hitting Gomez on the head trying to help him regain his memory.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Thing disappears from his box. Failing to find a single trace of Thing, Gomez (John Astin) conducts an investigation--with all members of the household under suspicion. Also starring Carolyn Jones, Jackie Coogan, and Ted Cassidy.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester applies for a job as an insurance salesman with the same company which is threatening to cancel the Addamses' policy (because Fester keeps blowing things up). Fester convinces the company interviewer that he is qualified for the job.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch becomes inconsolable when Gomez donates the family antique harpsichord to a collector. Gomez and Morticia offer Lurch a balalaika and a set of drums. When this proves unsatisfactory, Gomez and Fester decide to build a new harpsichord.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Morticia hears the stock market has crashed, she assumes that Gomez has been financially wiped out and rallies the family to help make money. Morticia gives lessons, Lurch and Fester run an escort service, and the kids run a poison drink stand.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: While enjoying a moonlight picnic and snail hunt, the Addams Family is mistaken for Martians by uniformed investigators from Mysterious Space Objects Headquarters. In turn, Gomez (John Astin) and the clan regard their inquisitors with suspicion.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: An organ grinder's fugitive monkey leads Fester to believe that he has turned Pugsley into a monkey. Morticia and Gomez treat the monkey as though he were their son, welcoming him to the dinner table and giving him Pugsley's chores.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Moriticia's favorite charity is having an auction--so Morticia persuades her family to part with things to sell. Donations include Wednesday's headless doll, the old flogging table, a stuffed vulture and Uncle Fester's dynamite.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The Addams Family ignores notices that their house is to be condemned to make way for a freeway. When sudden explosions cannot be traced to any member of the family but, instead, to city workmen, Gomez is forced to consider moving the house.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester's pen pal, Madelyn, is coming to visit. Fester panics, as he has described himself as handsome, heroic and romantic. Gomez and Morticia agree that all Fester needs is a toupee and they help him make several styles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez are worried about Cousin Itt because he spends his days sleeping and dreaming in his tiny room. They decide that Itt would make an excellent marriage counselor, and pretend to be a couple with a failing marriage.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: A recording company's platter of Lurch's gravelly voice brings a screaming mob of teenage fans to the Addams house. To calm the crowd, Lurch seats himself at the harpsichord and rewards his fans with a song to end all songs.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Taken in by a psychologist's pronouncement that the only happily married couples are those who fight, members of the Addams household devise schemes to start a battle between Gomez (John Astin) and Morticia (Carolyn Jones).

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez decides to bolster Cousin Itt's failing ego by making him the star of a production aimed as a birthday surprise for Wednesday. He hires the great director, Eric von Bissell, who gives Itt elocution lessons, causing a Hollywood star complex.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: While Morticia and Gomez are celebrating their 13th wedding anniversary, she tells Wednesday and Pugsley a bedtime story of how she and Gomez first met. In this episode, Carolyn Jones plays Morticia, Morticia as a 22-year-old, and sister Ophelia.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Wednesday and Pugsley refuse to go to bed until they hear the rest of the courtship story. Morticia resumes the tale via flashback, including the ceremony beginning with Ophelia Frump, Morticia's balmy sister, as the bride.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Romance seems close for Thing, the Addams right-hand-in-a-box, when Gomez's aunt arrives for a visit accompanied by Lady Fingers, her handmaiden. Thing enjoys the visit most because it gives him a chance to hold hands with one of his own kind.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez visit Mayor Henson to complain that their property tax is ridiculously low. After the Mayor proves his incompetence by offering a refund, Gomez is persuaded to become a candidate for the office.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: During a welcome home party for Cousin Itt, Morticia notices that the diminutive guest of honor seems to be losing his hair. Uncle Fester experiments with his chemistry set to produce a concoction that grows hair and tries the remedy on Itt.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Wednesday and Pugsley return in tears from trick-or-treating because a neighbor has told them there is no such thing as a witch. Morticia and Gomez plan to prove to the children that they do exist--by summoning a witch to a séance.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Determined to correct the dreadful literature that Wednesday and Pugsley are exposed to, Morticia sets out to create a new literary world. Gomez fears that his wife's first manuscript is so good, that once the publisher reads it, he will lose her.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: In need of artistic fulfillment, Morticia takes up sculpting. An art critic views her first endeavor--a three-eyed Gomez statue--and clubs it with his cane. Gomez, who won't have Morticia's heart broken gets, a seedy art dealer to buy it.

programme.desc: Pugsley copies one of his dad's old love letters and sends it to his teacher. Miss Dunbar comes to visit the Addams home and confesses to Gomez that no man has ever fallen so in love with her, leading Morticia to pretend to be the jealous wife.

programme.title: Teleshopping
टेलीशॉपिंग
டெலிஷாப்பிங்
టెలీషాపింగ్
programme.desc: The host showcases the features of a variety of products manufactured by renowned brands that can be purchased from the comfort of one's home.
प्रस्तुतकर्ता प्रसिद्ध ब्रांडों द्वारा निर्मित विभिन्न प्रकार के उत्पादों की विशेषताओं को पेश करते हैं, जिन्हें घर बैठे खरीदा जा सकता है।
பிரபல பிராண்டுகள் தயாரிக்கும், வீட்டிலிருந்தே வாங்கக்கூடிய பல்வேறு வகையான தயாரிப்புகளின் அம்சங்களை பற்றி அறிக.
వ్యాఖ్యాత ఇంటినుండే సౌకర్యంగా కొనుగోలు చేయగల వివిధ రకాల ప్రముఖ బ్రాండెడ్ ఉత్పత్తుల ప్రత్యేకతలు, ఇతర వివరాలను తెలుపుతారు.

programme.title: Jadui Nagari
जादुई नगरी
ஜாதுய் நகரி
జాదుయి నగరి
programme.desc: A collection of animated stories that apprise the viewers of valuable life lessons and inculcate moral values and sentiments.
एनिमेटेड कहानियों का एक संग्रह जो दर्शकों को मूल्यवान जीवन के सबक से अवगत कराता है और नैतिक मूल्यों और भावनाओं को विकसित करता है।
மதிப்புமிக்க வாழ்க்கை பாடங்களை மக்களுக்கு தெரிவிக்கும் மற்றும் தார்மீக மதிப்புகளை வளர்க்கும் அனிமேஷன் கதைகளின் தொகுப்பு.
వీక్షకులకు విలువైన జీవిత పాఠాలను తెలియజేస్తూ, నైతిక విలువలను, సద్భావనలను పెంపొందించే యానిమేటెడ్ కథల సమాహారం.

programme.title: Daravni Kahaniya
डरावनी कहानियाँ
தராவ்னி கஹானியா
దారావిని కహానియా
programme.desc: A selection of scary, creepy and thrilling stories featuring various characters from different backgrounds is presented.
विभिन्न पृष्ठभूमियों के विभिन्न पात्रों पर आधारित डरावनी, खौफनाक और रोमांचक कहानियों का संकलन प्रस्तुत किया जाता है।
வெவ்வேறு பின்னணிகளைச் சேர்ந்த பல்வேறு கதாபாத்திரங்களைக் கொண்ட பயங்கரமான மற்றும் சிலிர்ப்பூட்டும் கதைகளின் தொகுப்பு.
విభిన్న నేపథ్యాల నుండి వచ్చిన వివిధ పాత్రలతో కూడిన భయానక, గగుర్పాటు కలిగించే, ఉత్కంఠభరితమైన కథల ప్రసారం.

programme.title: Super Comedy Express
सुपर कॉमेडी एक्सप्रेस
சூப்பர் காமெடி எக்ஸ்பிரஸ்
సూపర్ కామెడీ ఎక్స్‌ప్రెస్
programme.desc: Renowned comedians from the Marathi entertainment industry perform various stand-up acts and skits to entertain the audience.
मराठी मनोरंजन उद्योग के प्रसिद्ध हास्य कलाकार दर्शकों का मनोरंजन करने के लिए विभिन्न स्टैंड-अप एक्ट और स्किट करते हैं।
பார்வையாளர்களை மகிழ்விப்பதற்காக மராத்தி நகைச்சுவை நடிகர்கள் பல்வேறு ஸ்டாண்ட்-அப் நிகழ்ச்சிகளை நிகழ்த்துகிறார்கள்.
మరాఠీ వినోద పరిశ్రమకు చెందిన హాస్యనటులు స్టాండ్-అప్ యాక్టింగ్‌లు, స్కిట్‌లను ప్రదర్శిస్తూ ప్రేక్షకులను అలరిస్తారు.

programme.title: Maskari
मस्करी
மஸ்கரி
మస్కరి
programme.desc: A confident and fun-loving young man gets into comedic situations as he lives his life and spends time with his family and friends.
एक आत्मविश्वासी और मौज-मस्ती पसंद करने वाला युवक अपनी जिंदगी जीते हुए और अपने परिवार और दोस्तों के साथ समय बिताते हुए हास्यपूर्ण स्थितियों में फंस जाता है।
தனது வாழ்க்கையை வாழும்போதும், குடும்பம்-நண்பர்களுடன் நேரத்தை செலவிடும்போதும் நகைச்சுவை சூழ்நிலைகளில் சிக்கும் இளைஞர்.
సరదాగా ఉండే ఒక యువకుడు, తన కుటుంబ సభ్యులతో, స్నేహితులతో సమయం గడిపే క్రమంలో హాస్యభరితమైన పరిస్థితులలో చిక్కుకుంటాడు.

एक आत्मविश्वासी और मौज-मस्ती पसंद करने वाला युवक अपनी जिंदगी जीते हुए और अपने परिवार और दोस्तों के साथ समय बिताते हुए हास्यपूर्ण स्थितियों में फंस जाता है।
தனது வாழ்க்கையை வாழும்போதும், குடும்பம்-நண்பர்களுடன் நேரத்தை செலவிடும்போதும் நகைச்சுவை சூழ்நிலைகளில் சிக்கும் இளைஞர்.
సరదాగా ఉండే ఒక యువకుడు, తన కుటుంబ సభ్యులతో, స్నేహితులతో సమయం గడిపే క్రమంలో హాస్యభరితమైన పరిస్థితులలో చిక్కుకుంటాడు.

programme.title: Mridul Ki Duniya
मृदुल की दुनिया
ம்ருதுல் கி துனியா
మృదుల్ కి దునియా
programme.desc: Living with their stern mother and frugal father, Mridul and his brother Nitin devise plans to obtain some extra cash and get into amusing mishaps along the way.
अपनी सख्त मां और मितव्ययी पिता के साथ रहते हुए, मृदुल और उसका भाई नितिन कुछ अतिरिक्त नकदी प्राप्त करने की योजना बनाते हैं और इस दौरान मनोरंजक दुर्घटनाओं के कारण बनते हैं।
மிருதுலும் அவரது சகோதரர் நிதினும் பணம் சம்பாதிக்கவும், விபத்துக்களில் சிக்கிக் கொள்ளவும் திட்டங்களை வகுக்கிறார்கள்.
పిసినారి తండ్రి, తల్లితో కలిసుంటున్న మృదుల్, అతడి సోదరుడు నితిన్ డబ్బు పొందే క్రమంలో సరదా పరిస్థితుల్లో చిక్కుకుంటారు.

programme.title: Yaar Mera Superstar
यार मेरा सूपरस्टार
யார் மேரா சூப்பர்ஸ்டார்
యార్ మేరా సూపర్‌స్టార్
programme.desc: The host engages in hilarious conversations with actors and celebrities about their success stories and incidents that offer moral lessons from their lives.
प्रस्तुतकर्ता, अभिनेताओं और मशहूर हस्तियों के साथ उनकी सफलता की कहानियों और उनके जीवन से नैतिक शिक्षा प्रदान करने वाली घटनाओं के बारे में हास्यपूर्ण बातचीत करते हैं।
நடிகர்கள்-பிரபலங்களுடன் அவர்களின் வெற்றிக் கதைகள் மற்றும் வாழ்க்கையில் நடந்த சம்பவங்கள் குறித்து பேசும் தொகுப்பாளர்.
వ్యాఖ్యాత పలువురు నటులు, సెలబ్రిటీలతో వారి విజయాలు, తమ జీవితంలో నైతిక పాఠాలు నేర్చుకున్న సంఘటనల గురించి సంభాషిస్తారు.

programme.title: Teleshopping
टेलीशॉपिंग
டெலிஷாப்பிங்
టెలీషాపింగ్
programme.desc: The host showcases the features of a variety of products manufactured by renowned brands that can be purchased from the comfort of one's home.
प्रस्तुतकर्ता प्रसिद्ध ब्रांडों द्वारा निर्मित विभिन्न प्रकार के उत्पादों की विशेषताओं को पेश करते हैं, जिन्हें घर बैठे खरीदा जा सकता है।
பிரபல பிராண்டுகள் தயாரிக்கும், வீட்டிலிருந்தே வாங்கக்கூடிய பல்வேறு வகையான தயாரிப்புகளின் அம்சங்களை பற்றி அறிக.
వ్యాఖ్యాత ఇంటినుండే సౌకర్యంగా కొనుగోలు చేయగల వివిధ రకాల ప్రముఖ బ్రాండెడ్ ఉత్పత్తుల ప్రత్యేకతలు, ఇతర వివరాలను తెలుపుతారు.

programme.title: BakLol
बकलोल
பாக்லோக்
బక్లోల్
programme.desc: Individuals from different walks of life respond to problems and situations in a comedic way, creating humorous experiences.
विभिन्न क्षेत्रों के व्यक्ति समस्याओं और स्थितियों पर हास्यपूर्ण तरीके से प्रतिक्रिया देते हैं, जिससे हास्यपूर्ण परिस्थितियाँ उत्पन्न होती हैं।
பல்வேறு நபர்கள் தங்களின் நகைச்சுவைகளுடன் ஒருவருக்கு ஒருவர் உதவுவதன் மூலம் அவர்களின் அன்றாட பிரச்சனைகளை சமாளிக்கின்றனர்.
వివిధ వ్యక్తులు ఒకరికొకరు ఉల్లాసమైన రీతిలో సహాయం చేసుకోవడం ద్వారా వారి రోజువారీ సమస్యలను పరిష్కరించుకుంటారు.

programme.title: Sweety Special
स्वीटी स्पेशल
ஸ்வீட்டி ஸ்பெஷல்
స్వీటీ స్పెషల్
programme.desc: A woman named Sweety gets into comedic situations that are reminiscent of people's daily lives and relatable experiences.
स्वीटी नाम की एक महिला ऐसी हास्य स्थितियों में फंस जाती है जो लोगों के दैनिक जीवन और संबंधित अनुभवों की याद दिलाती है।
ஸ்வீட்டி, மக்களின் அன்றாட வாழ்க்கை மற்றும் தொடர்புடைய அனுபவங்களை நினைவூட்டும் நகைச்சுவையான சூழ்நிலைகளில் ஈடுபடுகிறார்.
స్వీటీ అనే మహిళ, ప్రజల దైనందిన జీవితాలు, సంబంధిత అనుభవాలను గుర్తుచేసే హాస్యభరితమైన పరిస్థితులలోకి వస్తుంది.

పిసినారి తండ్రి, తల్లితో కలిసుంటున్న మృదుల్, అతడి సోదరుడు నితిన్ డబ్బు పొందే క్రమంలో సరదా పరిస్థితుల్లో చిక్కుకుంటారు.

programme.title: Teleshopping
टेलीशॉपिंग
டெலிஷாப்பிங்
టెలీషాపింగ్
programme.desc: The host showcases the features of a variety of products manufactured by renowned brands that can be purchased from the comfort of one's home.
प्रस्तुतकर्ता प्रसिद्ध ब्रांडों द्वारा निर्मित विभिन्न प्रकार के उत्पादों की विशेषताओं को पेश करते हैं, जिन्हें घर बैठे खरीदा जा सकता है।
பிரபல பிராண்டுகள் தயாரிக்கும், வீட்டிலிருந்தே வாங்கக்கூடிய பல்வேறு வகையான தயாரிப்புகளின் அம்சங்களை பற்றி அறிக.
వ్యాఖ్యాత ఇంటినుండే సౌకర్యంగా కొనుగోలు చేయగల వివిధ రకాల ప్రముఖ బ్రాండెడ్ ఉత్పత్తుల ప్రత్యేకతలు, ఇతర వివరాలను తెలుపుతారు.

programme.title: Super Comedy Express
सुपर कॉमेडी एक्सप्रेस
சூப்பர் காமெடி எக்ஸ்பிரஸ்
సూపర్ కామెడీ ఎక్స్‌ప్రెస్
programme.desc: Renowned comedians from the Marathi entertainment industry perform various stand-up acts and skits to entertain the audience.
मराठी मनोरंजन उद्योग के प्रसिद्ध हास्य कलाकार दर्शकों का मनोरंजन करने के लिए विभिन्न स्टैंड-अप एक्ट और स्किट करते हैं।
பார்வையாளர்களை மகிழ்விப்பதற்காக மராத்தி நகைச்சுவை நடிகர்கள் பல்வேறு ஸ்டாண்ட்-அப் நிகழ்ச்சிகளை நிகழ்த்துகிறார்கள்.
మరాఠీ వినోద పరిశ్రమకు చెందిన హాస్యనటులు స్టాండ్-అప్ యాక్టింగ్‌లు, స్కిట్‌లను ప్రదర్శిస్తూ ప్రేక్షకులను అలరిస్తారు.

programme.title: Yaar Mera Superstar
यार मेरा सूपरस्टार
யார் மேரா சூப்பர்ஸ்டார்
యార్ మేరా సూపర్‌స్టార్
programme.desc: The host engages in hilarious conversations with actors and celebrities about their success stories and incidents that offer moral lessons from their lives.
प्रस्तुतकर्ता, अभिनेताओं और मशहूर हस्तियों के साथ उनकी सफलता की कहानियों और उनके जीवन से नैतिक शिक्षा प्रदान करने वाली घटनाओं के बारे में हास्यपूर्ण बातचीत करते हैं।
நடிகர்கள்-பிரபலங்களுடன் அவர்களின் வெற்றிக் கதைகள் மற்றும் வாழ்க்கையில் நடந்த சம்பவங்கள் குறித்து பேசும் தொகுப்பாளர்.
వ్యాఖ్యాత పలువురు నటులు, సెలబ్రిటీలతో వారి విజయాలు, తమ జీవితంలో నైతిక పాఠాలు నేర్చుకున్న సంఘటనల గురించి సంభాషిస్తారు.

programme.title: Maskari
मस्करी
மஸ்கரி
మస్కరి
programme.desc: A confident and fun-loving young man gets into comedic situations as he lives his life and spends time with his family and friends.
एक आत्मविश्वासी और मौज-मस्ती पसंद करने वाला युवक अपनी जिंदगी जीते हुए और अपने परिवार और दोस्तों के साथ समय बिताते हुए हास्यपूर्ण स्थितियों में फंस जाता है।
தனது வாழ்க்கையை வாழும்போதும், குடும்பம்-நண்பர்களுடன் நேரத்தை செலவிடும்போதும் நகைச்சுவை சூழ்நிலைகளில் சிக்கும் இளைஞர்.
సరదాగా ఉండే ఒక యువకుడు, తన కుటుంబ సభ్యులతో, స్నేహితులతో సమయం గడిపే క్రమంలో హాస్యభరితమైన పరిస్థితులలో చిక్కుకుంటాడు.

मृदुल की दुनिया
ம்ருதுல் கி துனியா
మృదుల్ కి దునియా
programme.desc: Living with their stern mother and frugal father, Mridul and his brother Nitin devise plans to obtain some extra cash and get into amusing mishaps along the way.
अपनी सख्त मां और मितव्ययी पिता के साथ रहते हुए, मृदुल और उसका भाई नितिन कुछ अतिरिक्त नकदी प्राप्त करने की योजना बनाते हैं और इस दौरान मनोरंजक दुर्घटनाओं के कारण बनते हैं।

programme.title: Sweety Special
स्वीटी स्पेशल
ஸ்வீட்டி ஸ்பெஷல்
స్వీటీ స్పెషల్
programme.desc: A woman named Sweety gets into comedic situations that are reminiscent of people's daily lives and relatable experiences.
स्वीटी नाम की एक महिला ऐसी हास्य स्थितियों में फंस जाती है जो लोगों के दैनिक जीवन और संबंधित अनुभवों की याद दिलाती है।
ஸ்வீட்டி, மக்களின் அன்றாட வாழ்க்கை மற்றும் தொடர்புடைய அனுபவங்களை நினைவூட்டும் நகைச்சுவையான சூழ்நிலைகளில் ஈடுபடுகிறார்.
స్వీటీ అనే మహిళ, ప్రజల దైనందిన జీవితాలు, సంబంధిత అనుభవాలను గుర్తుచేసే హాస్యభరితమైన పరిస్థితులలోకి వస్తుంది.

programme.title: Tenali Rama
तेनाली रामा
தெனாலி ராமா
తెనాలి రామ
programme.desc: Court poet Tenali Rama serves at the court of Emperor Krishnadevaraya of the Vijayanagara empire and uses his sharp wit and wisdom to solve complicated matters quickly.
तेनाली रामा, विजयनगर साम्राज्य के सम्राट कृष्णदेवराय के दरबार में कवि और सलाहकार हैं। वह, राज्य और जनता के कठिन मामलों को सुलझाने के लिए अपनी तेज बुद्धि का उपयोग करते हैं।
தெனாலிராமன், சிக்கலான விஷயங்களை விரைவாகத் தீர்க்க தனது கூர்மையான புத்திசாலித்தனத்தையும் ஞானத்தையும் பயன்படுத்துகிறார்.
విజయనగర సామ్రాజ్య చక్రవర్తి శ్రీ కృష్ణదేవరాయల ఆస్థాన కవి తెనాలి రాముడు, తన తెలివితో క్లిష్టమైన సమస్యలను పరిష్కరిస్తాడు.

programme.title: BakLol
बकलोल
பாக்லோக்
బక్లోల్
programme.desc: Individuals from different walks of life respond to problems and situations in a comedic way, creating humorous experiences.
विभिन्न क्षेत्रों के व्यक्ति समस्याओं और स्थितियों पर हास्यपूर्ण तरीके से प्रतिक्रिया देते हैं, जिससे हास्यपूर्ण परिस्थितियाँ उत्पन्न होती हैं।
பல்வேறு நபர்கள் தங்களின் நகைச்சுவைகளுடன் ஒருவருக்கு ஒருவர் உதவுவதன் மூலம் அவர்களின் அன்றாட பிரச்சனைகளை சமாளிக்கின்றனர்.
వివిధ వ్యక్తులు ఒకరికొకరు ఉల్లాసమైన రీతిలో సహాయం చేసుకోవడం ద్వారా వారి రోజువారీ సమస్యలను పరిష్కరించుకుంటారు.

మరాఠీ వినోద పరిశ్రమకు చెందిన హాస్యనటులు స్టాండ్-అప్ యాక్టింగ్‌లు, స్కిట్‌లను ప్రదర్శిస్తూ ప్రేక్షకులను అలరిస్తారు.

programme.title: Rishto Ki Dor
रिश्तो की डोर
ரிஷ்தோ கி தோர்
రిష్తో కి డోర్
programme.desc: A collection of stories from people's daily lives, which teaches valuable lessons about being a good human being, is presented.
लोगों के दैनिक जीवन की कहानियों का संग्रह प्रस्तुत किया जाता है, जो एक अच्छे इंसान बनने के लिए अच्छे सबक सिखाता है।
மதிப்புமிக்க பாடங்களைக் கற்பிக்கும், மக்களின் அன்றாட வாழ்க்கையிலிருந்து வரும் கதைகளின் தொகுப்பு வழங்கப்படுகிறது.
తల్లిదండ్రుల మరణం తరువాత తన ముగ్గురు చెల్లెళ్లను చూసుకోవడానికి చాలా కష్టపడుతున్న సుహాస్ చాలా సవాళ్లను ఎదుర్కొంటాడు.

programme.title: Teleshopping
टेलीशॉपिंग
டெலிஷாப்பிங்
టెలీషాపింగ్
programme.desc: The host showcases the features of a variety of products manufactured by renowned brands that can be purchased from the comfort of one's home.
प्रस्तुतकर्ता प्रसिद्ध ब्रांडों द्वारा निर्मित विभिन्न प्रकार के उत्पादों की विशेषताओं को पेश करते हैं, जिन्हें घर बैठे खरीदा जा सकता है।
பிரபல பிராண்டுகள் தயாரிக்கும், வீட்டிலிருந்தே வாங்கக்கூடிய பல்வேறு வகையான தயாரிப்புகளின் அம்சங்களை பற்றி அறிக.

programme.title: Jadui Nagari
जादुई नगरी
ஜாதுய் நகரி
జాదుయి నగరి
programme.desc: A collection of animated stories that apprise the viewers of valuable life lessons and inculcate moral values and sentiments.
एनिमेटेड कहानियों का एक संग्रह जो दर्शकों को मूल्यवान जीवन के सबक से अवगत कराता है और नैतिक मूल्यों और भावनाओं को विकसित करता है।
மதிப்புமிக்க வாழ்க்கை பாடங்களை மக்களுக்கு தெரிவிக்கும் மற்றும் தார்மீக மதிப்புகளை வளர்க்கும் அனிமேஷன் கதைகளின் தொகுப்பு.
వీక్షకులకు విలువైన జీవిత పాఠాలను తెలియజేస్తూ, నైతిక విలువలను, సద్భావనలను పెంపొందించే యానిమేటెడ్ కథల సమాహారం.

programme.title: Daravni Kahaniya
डरावनी कहानियाँ
தராவ்னி கஹானியா
దారావిని కహానియా
programme.desc: A selection of scary, creepy and thrilling stories featuring various characters from different backgrounds is presented.
विभिन्न पृष्ठभूमियों के विभिन्न पात्रों पर आधारित डरावनी, खौफनाक और रोमांचक कहानियों का संकलन प्रस्तुत किया जाता है।
வெவ்வேறு பின்னணிகளைச் சேர்ந்த பல்வேறு கதாபாத்திரங்களைக் கொண்ட பயங்கரமான மற்றும் சிலிர்ப்பூட்டும் கதைகளின் தொகுப்பு.
విభిన్న నేపథ్యాల నుండి వచ్చిన వివిధ పాత్రలతో కూడిన భయానక, గగుర్పాటు కలిగించే, ఉత్కంఠభరితమైన కథల ప్రసారం.

programme.title: Super Comedy Express
सुपर कॉमेडी एक्सप्रेस
சூப்பர் காமெடி எக்ஸ்பிரஸ்
సూపర్ కామెడీ ఎక్స్‌ప్రెస్
programme.desc: Renowned comedians from the Marathi entertainment industry perform various stand-up acts and skits to entertain the audience.
मराठी मनोरंजन उद्योग के प्रसिद्ध हास्य कलाकार दर्शकों का मनोरंजन करने के लिए विभिन्न स्टैंड-अप एक्ट और स्किट करते हैं।
பார்வையாளர்களை மகிழ்விப்பதற்காக மராத்தி நகைச்சுவை நடிகர்கள் பல்வேறு ஸ்டாண்ட்-அப் நிகழ்ச்சிகளை நிகழ்த்துகிறார்கள்.
మరాఠీ వినోద పరిశ్రమకు చెందిన హాస్యనటులు స్టాండ్-అప్ యాక్టింగ్‌లు, స్కిట్‌లను ప్రదర్శిస్తూ ప్రేక్షకులను అలరిస్తారు.

మస్కరి
programme.desc: A confident and fun-loving young man gets into comedic situations as he lives his life and spends time with his family and friends.
एक आत्मविश्वासी और मौज-मस्ती पसंद करने वाला युवक अपनी जिंदगी जीते हुए और अपने परिवार और दोस्तों के साथ समय बिताते हुए हास्यपूर्ण स्थितियों में फंस जाता है।
தனது வாழ்க்கையை வாழும்போதும், குடும்பம்-நண்பர்களுடன் நேரத்தை செலவிடும்போதும் நகைச்சுவை சூழ்நிலைகளில் சிக்கும் இளைஞர்.
సరదాగా ఉండే ఒక యువకుడు, తన కుటుంబ సభ్యులతో, స్నేహితులతో సమయం గడిపే క్రమంలో హాస్యభరితమైన పరిస్థితులలో చిక్కుకుంటాడు.

programme.title: Tenali Rama
तेनाली रामा
தெனாலி ராமா
తెనాలి రామ
programme.desc: Court poet Tenali Rama serves at the court of Emperor Krishnadevaraya of the Vijayanagara empire and uses his sharp wit and wisdom to solve complicated matters quickly.
तेनाली रामा, विजयनगर साम्राज्य के सम्राट कृष्णदेवराय के दरबार में कवि और सलाहकार हैं। वह, राज्य और जनता के कठिन मामलों को सुलझाने के लिए अपनी तेज बुद्धि का उपयोग करते हैं।
தெனாலிராமன், சிக்கலான விஷயங்களை விரைவாகத் தீர்க்க தனது கூர்மையான புத்திசாலித்தனத்தையும் ஞானத்தையும் பயன்படுத்துகிறார்.
విజయనగర సామ్రాజ్య చక్రవర్తి శ్రీ కృష్ణదేవరాయల ఆస్థాన కవి తెనాలి రాముడు, తన తెలివితో క్లిష్టమైన సమస్యలను పరిష్కరిస్తాడు.

programme.title: Mridul Ki Duniya
मृदुल की दुनिया
ம்ருதுல் கி துனியா
మృదుల్ కి దునియా
programme.desc: Living with their stern mother and frugal father, Mridul and his brother Nitin devise plans to obtain some extra cash and get into amusing mishaps along the way.
अपनी सख्त मां और मितव्ययी पिता के साथ रहते हुए, मृदुल और उसका भाई नितिन कुछ अतिरिक्त नकदी प्राप्त करने की योजना बनाते हैं और इस दौरान मनोरंजक दुर्घटनाओं के कारण बनते हैं।
மிருதுலும் அவரது சகோதரர் நிதினும் பணம் சம்பாதிக்கவும், விபத்துக்களில் சிக்கிக் கொள்ளவும் திட்டங்களை வகுக்கிறார்கள்.
పిసినారి తండ్రి, తల్లితో కలిసుంటున్న మృదుల్, అతడి సోదరుడు నితిన్ డబ్బు పొందే క్రమంలో సరదా పరిస్థితుల్లో చిక్కుకుంటారు.

programme.title: Yaar Mera Superstar
यार मेरा सूपरस्टार
யார் மேரா சூப்பர்ஸ்டார்
యార్ మేరా సూపర్‌స్టార్
programme.desc: The host engages in hilarious conversations with actors and celebrities about their success stories and incidents that offer moral lessons from their lives.
प्रस्तुतकर्ता, अभिनेताओं और मशहूर हस्तियों के साथ उनकी सफलता की कहानियों और उनके जीवन से नैतिक शिक्षा प्रदान करने वाली घटनाओं के बारे में हास्यपूर्ण बातचीत करते हैं।
நடிகர்கள்-பிரபலங்களுடன் அவர்களின் வெற்றிக் கதைகள் மற்றும் வாழ்க்கையில் நடந்த சம்பவங்கள் குறித்து பேசும் தொகுப்பாளர்.
వ్యాఖ్యాత పలువురు నటులు, సెలబ్రిటీలతో వారి విజయాలు, తమ జీవితంలో నైతిక పాఠాలు నేర్చుకున్న సంఘటనల గురించి సంభాషిస్తారు.

programme.title: Teleshopping
टेलीशॉपिंग
டெலிஷாப்பிங்
టెలీషాపింగ్
programme.desc: The host showcases the features of a variety of products manufactured by renowned brands that can be purchased from the comfort of one's home.
प्रस्तुतकर्ता प्रसिद्ध ब्रांडों द्वारा निर्मित विभिन्न प्रकार के उत्पादों की विशेषताओं को पेश करते हैं, जिन्हें घर बैठे खरीदा जा सकता है।
பிரபல பிராண்டுகள் தயாரிக்கும், வீட்டிலிருந்தே வாங்கக்கூடிய பல்வேறு வகையான தயாரிப்புகளின் அம்சங்களை பற்றி அறிக.
వ్యాఖ్యాత ఇంటినుండే సౌకర్యంగా కొనుగోలు చేయగల వివిధ రకాల ప్రముఖ బ్రాండెడ్ ఉత్పత్తుల ప్రత్యేకతలు, ఇతర వివరాలను తెలుపుతారు.

programme.title: BakLol
बकलोल
பாக்லோக்
బక్లోల్
programme.desc: Individuals from different walks of life respond to problems and situations in a comedic way, creating humorous experiences.
विभिन्न क्षेत्रों के व्यक्ति समस्याओं और स्थितियों पर हास्यपूर्ण तरीके से प्रतिक्रिया देते हैं, जिससे हास्यपूर्ण परिस्थितियाँ उत्पन्न होती हैं।
பல்வேறு நபர்கள் தங்களின் நகைச்சுவைகளுடன் ஒருவருக்கு ஒருவர் உதவுவதன் மூலம் அவர்களின் அன்றாட பிரச்சனைகளை சமாளிக்கின்றனர்.
వివిధ వ్యక్తులు ఒకరికొకరు ఉల్లాసమైన రీతిలో సహాయం చేసుకోవడం ద్వారా వారి రోజువారీ సమస్యలను పరిష్కరించుకుంటారు.

programme.title: Sweety Special
स्वीटी स्पेशल
ஸ்வீட்டி ஸ்பெஷல்
స్వీటీ స్పెషల్
programme.desc: A woman named Sweety gets into comedic situations that are reminiscent of people's daily lives and relatable experiences.
स्वीटी नाम की एक महिला ऐसी हास्य स्थितियों में फंस जाती है जो लोगों के दैनिक जीवन और संबंधित अनुभवों की याद दिलाती है।
ஸ்வீட்டி, மக்களின் அன்றாட வாழ்க்கை மற்றும் தொடர்புடைய அனுபவங்களை நினைவூட்டும் நகைச்சுவையான சூழ்நிலைகளில் ஈடுபடுகிறார்.
స్వీటీ అనే మహిళ, ప్రజల దైనందిన జీవితాలు, సంబంధిత అనుభవాలను గుర్తుచేసే హాస్యభరితమైన పరిస్థితులలోకి వస్తుంది.

programme.desc: The host showcases the features of a variety of products manufactured by renowned brands that can be purchased from the comfort of one's home.
प्रस्तुतकर्ता प्रसिद्ध ब्रांडों द्वारा निर्मित विभिन्न प्रकार के उत्पादों की विशेषताओं को पेश करते हैं, जिन्हें घर बैठे खरीदा जा सकता है।
பிரபல பிராண்டுகள் தயாரிக்கும், வீட்டிலிருந்தே வாங்கக்கூடிய பல்வேறு வகையான தயாரிப்புகளின் அம்சங்களை பற்றி அறிக.
వ్యాఖ్యాత ఇంటినుండే సౌకర్యంగా కొనుగోలు చేయగల వివిధ రకాల ప్రముఖ బ్రాండెడ్ ఉత్పత్తుల ప్రత్యేకతలు, ఇతర వివరాలను తెలుపుతారు.

programme.title: Super Comedy Express
सुपर कॉमेडी एक्सप्रेस
சூப்பர் காமெடி எக்ஸ்பிரஸ்
సూపర్ కామెడీ ఎక్స్‌ప్రెస్
programme.desc: Renowned comedians from the Marathi entertainment industry perform various stand-up acts and skits to entertain the audience.
मराठी मनोरंजन उद्योग के प्रसिद्ध हास्य कलाकार दर्शकों का मनोरंजन करने के लिए विभिन्न स्टैंड-अप एक्ट और स्किट करते हैं।
பார்வையாளர்களை மகிழ்விப்பதற்காக மராத்தி நகைச்சுவை நடிகர்கள் பல்வேறு ஸ்டாண்ட்-அப் நிகழ்ச்சிகளை நிகழ்த்துகிறார்கள்.
మరాఠీ వినోద పరిశ్రమకు చెందిన హాస్యనటులు స్టాండ్-అప్ యాక్టింగ్‌లు, స్కిట్‌లను ప్రదర్శిస్తూ ప్రేక్షకులను అలరిస్తారు.

यार मेरा सूपरस्टार
யார் மேரா சூப்பர்ஸ்டார்

programme.desc: The host engages in hilarious conversations with actors and celebrities about their success stories and incidents that offer moral lessons from their lives.

நடிகர்கள்-பிரபலங்களுடன் அவர்களின் வெற்றிக் கதைகள் மற்றும் வாழ்க்கையில் நடந்த சம்பவங்கள் குறித்து பேசும் தொகுப்பாளர்.
వ్యాఖ్యాత పలువురు నటులు, సెలబ్రిటీలతో వారి విజయాలు, తమ జీవితంలో నైతిక పాఠాలు నేర్చుకున్న సంఘటనల గురించి సంభాషిస్తారు.

मस्करी
மஸ்கரி

programme.desc: A confident and fun-loving young man gets into comedic situations as he lives his life and spends time with his family and friends.
एक आत्मविश्वासी और मौज-मस्ती पसंद करने वाला युवक अपनी जिंदगी जीते हुए और अपने परिवार और दोस्तों के साथ समय बिताते हुए हास्यपूर्ण स्थितियों में फंस जाता है।
தனது வாழ்க்கையை வாழும்போதும், குடும்பம்-நண்பர்களுடன் நேரத்தை செலவிடும்போதும் நகைச்சுவை சூழ்நிலைகளில் சிக்கும் இளைஞர்.
సరదాగా ఉండే ఒక యువకుడు, తన కుటుంబ సభ్యులతో, స్నేహితులతో సమయం గడిపే క్రమంలో హాస్యభరితమైన పరిస్థితులలో చిక్కుకుంటాడు.

ஸ்வீட்டி ஸ்பெஷல்

programme.desc: A woman named Sweety gets into comedic situations that are reminiscent of people's daily lives and relatable experiences.
स्वीटी नाम की एक महिला ऐसी हास्य स्थितियों में फंस जाती है जो लोगों के दैनिक जीवन और संबंधित अनुभवों की याद दिलाती है।
ஸ்வீட்டி, மக்களின் அன்றாட வாழ்க்கை மற்றும் தொடர்புடைய அனுபவங்களை நினைவூட்டும் நகைச்சுவையான சூழ்நிலைகளில் ஈடுபடுகிறார்.
స్వీటీ అనే మహిళ, ప్రజల దైనందిన జీవితాలు, సంబంధిత అనుభవాలను గుర్తుచేసే హాస్యభరితమైన పరిస్థితులలోకి వస్తుంది.

programme.title: Tenali Rama
तेनाली रामा
தெனாலி ராமா
తెనాలి రామ
programme.desc: Court poet Tenali Rama serves at the court of Emperor Krishnadevaraya of the Vijayanagara empire and uses his sharp wit and wisdom to solve complicated matters quickly.
तेनाली रामा, विजयनगर साम्राज्य के सम्राट कृष्णदेवराय के दरबार में कवि और सलाहकार हैं। वह, राज्य और जनता के कठिन मामलों को सुलझाने के लिए अपनी तेज बुद्धि का उपयोग करते हैं।
தெனாலிராமன், சிக்கலான விஷயங்களை விரைவாகத் தீர்க்க தனது கூர்மையான புத்திசாலித்தனத்தையும் ஞானத்தையும் பயன்படுத்துகிறார்.
విజయనగర సామ్రాజ్య చక్రవర్తి శ్రీ కృష్ణదేవరాయల ఆస్థాన కవి తెనాలి రాముడు, తన తెలివితో క్లిష్టమైన సమస్యలను పరిష్కరిస్తాడు.

programme.title: BakLol
बकलोल
பாக்லோக்
బక్లోల్
programme.desc: Individuals from different walks of life respond to problems and situations in a comedic way, creating humorous experiences.
विभिन्न क्षेत्रों के व्यक्ति समस्याओं और स्थितियों पर हास्यपूर्ण तरीके से प्रतिक्रिया देते हैं, जिससे हास्यपूर्ण परिस्थितियाँ उत्पन्न होती हैं।
பல்வேறு நபர்கள் தங்களின் நகைச்சுவைகளுடன் ஒருவருக்கு ஒருவர் உதவுவதன் மூலம் அவர்களின் அன்றாட பிரச்சனைகளை சமாளிக்கின்றனர்.
వివిధ వ్యక్తులు ఒకరికొకరు ఉల్లాసమైన రీతిలో సహాయం చేసుకోవడం ద్వారా వారి రోజువారీ సమస్యలను పరిష్కరించుకుంటారు.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Le choc des mondes, 2e partie
programme.desc: Mikey a pris une décharge électrique fatale. Dregg débarque sur la planète avec son vaisseau, les tortues tentent par tous les moyens de sauver le monde.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Les aventures des Tortues Ninja (1/3)
programme.desc: Les tortues pensent être parvenues à vaincre leurs anciens ennemis, mais elles vont vite s'apercevoir qu'un nouveau mal est à l'œuvre.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Les aventures des Tortues Ninja (2/3)
programme.desc: À la recherche du Kuro Kabuto, Karaï se prétend héritière légitime du Clan des Foot quand elle tombe nez à nez avec un vieux rival.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Les aventures des Tortues Ninja (3/3)
programme.desc: L'animosité de Donatello envers Don Vizioso met la mission des tortues en péril.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Yojimbo
programme.desc: Les tortues débarquent dans un monde féodal peuplé d'animaux anthropomorphes.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Osoroshi no Tabi
programme.desc: Après avoir échappé aux soldats de Sumo Kuma, les tortues doivent affronter les Tanukis, des créatures versatiles, et Joroguma, la terrible femme-araignée.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Kagayake ! Kintaro
programme.desc: Il reste quelques étapes aux tortues, à Usagi et à Kintaro, avant de rallier le temple-palais du Bouddha Céleste. Mais prudence, l'emprise de Jei n'est jamais loin...

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Le guerrier des terres dévastées
programme.desc: Une bombe de mutagène a ravagé la Terre. Dans ce futur post-apocalyptique, Raph et Donnie affrontent le Clan des Blaireaux Maraudeurs du Bitume.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Le désert infranchissable
programme.desc: Dans un futur post-apocalyptique, Donnie le robot, Raph et Mira partent à la recherche du Grand Booyakasha qui peut déchiffrer la carte qui mène à Oasis.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Carmageddon
programme.desc: Raph met le cap sur Oasis, poursuivi par Maximus Kong. Le combat s'engage.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: L'apparition des tortues, 1ère partie
programme.desc: Splinter autorise enfin les tortues à remonter à la surface. Elles tentent de secourir une jeune fille mais s'aperçoivent qu'elles ne savent pas se battre en équipe.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: L'apparition des tortues, 2e partie
programme.desc: Les tortues apprennent qu'April et son père sont retenus prisonniers par les Krangs, de méchants extraterrestres déguisés en robots androïdes. Les tortues réussiront-elles à pénétrer dans le repaire de l'ennemi et à combattre en équipe ?

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Caractère de tortue
programme.desc: Raphael perd son sang-froid quand un vieux New-Yorkais fait une vidéo des Tortues Ninja en train de se battre contre les Krangs. Les tortues doivent mettre la main sur cette vidéo avant qu'elles ne tombent entre de mauvaises mains.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Nouvel ami, vieil ennemi
programme.desc: Pour prouver que les tortues ninja peuvent se lier d'amitié avec des humains, Michelangelo se fait un ami sur un réseau social. Mais cet ami est-il digne de confiance ?

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Je crois qu'il s'appelle Baxter Stockman
programme.sub-title: Je crois qu'il s'appelle Baxter Stockman
programme.desc: Lorsque les tortues quittent le repaire contre l'avis de Splinter, elles font la rencontre de Baxter Stockman, un inventeur dérangé vêtu d'une armure de combat.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Tête d'Acier
programme.desc: Las d'utiliser son bô contre la technologie extraterrestre des Krangs, Donatello crée Tête d'Acier, un robot télécommandé, pour se battre à sa place.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Malin comme un singe
programme.desc: En enquêtant sur la disparition d'un scientifique, Donatello et April croisent la route d'un singe au comportement bizarre et découvrent un complot.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Xever la menace
programme.desc: Léo pourrait regretter d'avoir fait preuve de clémence, quand Xever prend en otage le propriétaire d'un restaurant de nouilles chinoises.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Le défi
programme.desc: April reçoit un message alarmant de la part de son père prisonnier. Les tortues et elles partent en mission pour le sauver et empêcher les Krangs de faire exploser une bombe de mutagène en pleine ville.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Panique dans les égoûts
programme.desc: Les tortues sont obligées de défendre leur repaire dans les égoûts que Bradford veut détruire à l'aide d'un dangereux produit chimique.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: L'attaque des Mascottes !
programme.desc: Des menaces multiples forcent les tortues à se séparer en deux groupes. Donnie et Mikey doivent prouver que leur équipe de remplaçants a autant de valeur que l'équipe des champions composée par Léo et Raph.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: La créature venue des profondeurs
programme.desc: Michelangelo devient ami avec un alligator mutant déséquilibré qui est en possession d'un étrange outil de technologie appartenant aux Krangs. Mais est-il digne de confiance ?

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Une fille mystérieuse
programme.desc: Las d'entendre les critiques de Raph, Léo laisse son frère diriger l'équipe. Pendant ce temps, Léo rencontre une belle et dangereuse kunoïchi.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Le Roi des Rats
programme.desc: Les tortues doivent faire face à nouvel ennemi, le Roi des Rats, qui menace de prendre le contrôle de la ville, mais aussi de l'esprit de Splinter.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Le plan des Krangs
programme.desc: Quand les devoirs d'école d'April attirent l'attention des Krangs, les tortues prennent le lycée d'assaut.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Le Pulvériseur
programme.desc: Les tortues ont un problème avec le Pulvériseur, un adolescent qui se prend pour un héros et qui veut combattre le crime à leurs côtés.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Mystère au TCRI
programme.desc: En s'introduisant dans l'enceinte très surveillée du TCRI, les tortues découvrent les véritables intentions des Krangs.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Le cafard Terminator
programme.desc: Alors qu'elles tentent de déjouer le plan d'invasion de la Terre par les Krangs, les tortues sont pourchassées par un cafard géant et indestructible.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Le labyrinthe de la peur
programme.desc: Fatigué d'être humilié par Fishface et Dogpound, et de perdre face aux tortues, Baxter Stockman prépare sa vengeance.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: L'ennemi de mon ennemi
programme.desc: Après avoir vu les Krangs à l'œuvre, Karai propose une alliance aux tortues. Mais est-elle digne de confiance ?

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: La mission de Karaï
programme.desc: Le clan des Foot tente de capturer April, qui doit combattre Karaï si elle veut leur échapper.
